description: Find the Haveny articles that cover a California HOA board topic (discipline, elections, records, rule changes, fiduciary duties, business judgment rule). Use when the user is on a board or asking about board duties. Returns up to three articles, each with its title, link and a one-line topic. IMPORTANT: This tool returns a haveny.co article URL in its first line. Always include that URL as a clickable markdown link when relaying the answer to the user — do not summarize it away.

topic.description: The area of board duty to look up. Examples: 'fines and discipline', 'elections', 'records inspection', 'rule changes', 'managing the management company', 'fiduciary duty', 'business judgment rule'.

name: get_board_obligations
